shared_elements: three-dimensional carved figure in the round
low-relief detailing on the body surface
justification: Both are figures carved in the round with a defined head and lightly incised surface detail, but A depicts a heavy quadruped animal in profile with legs, muzzle and jaw, while B depicts a frontal anthropomorphic torso-and-head monolith with relief motifs (curved bands, discs, arcs) on the chest and back. The only correspondence is the generic fact of a sculpted creature with a head; there is no shared motif, posture, attribute or arrangement.
